scenario: One controlled LIVE execution of the operator-only INTEGRATION read_content diagnostic against a connected Facebook Page carrying a recent Page-authored post, using the deployed source revision, a single task attempt, a 30-day window and one list page. The connection held pages_read_engagement and pages_show_list and did not hold pages_read_user_content. listContent derived a Page access token and read one page of published posts; getContent derived a Page access token again and re-read the item selected from that same list result.
observedResult: listContent succeeded: one item returned, one item inside the window, content kind post, reported source unknown, Page identity correlated, continuation present and normalized into a valid PageCursor. getContent succeeded on the selected listed item: same ref, same managed account, same content kind. Four Meta GET requests inferred from the executed stages. No authorization, credential, rate-limit or transient failure. No product profile, outbox or catalog change.
